tools.name: duration_of_daily_spend
tools.title: Duration Of Daily Spend
tools.description: How long a wealth would last if a fixed amount were spent every day. Answers "how long would it take to spend a billion dollars?"

wealth.description: Amount of money. Accepts plain numbers ("1000000000"), formatted numbers ("1,000,000,000"), or shorthand ("1B", "750B", "1T"). Currency defaults to USD.

tools.name: height_of_money_stack
tools.title: Height Of Money Stack
tools.description: How high a wealth would stack as physical currency, across 11 currencies. No currency conversion is performed — typeOfMoney's currency overrides any symbol on wealth.

wealth.description: Amount of money. Accepts plain numbers ("1000000000"), formatted numbers ("1,000,000,000"), or shorthand ("1B", "750B", "1T"). Currency defaults to USD.

typeOfMoney.description: Money slug. Denomination to stack, across 11 currencies. Coins stack far higher than bills — pick coins for maximum contrast. The slug's currency overrides any currency given for wealth (no conversion is done). One of: usd_1_coin (Dollar Coins (USD)); usd_100_bill (Hundred-Dollar Bills (USD)); cad_1_coin (Loonies (CAD)); cad_100_bill (Hundred-Dollar Bills (CAD)); eur_1_coin (Euro Coins); eur_100_bill (Hundred-Euro Bills); gbp_1_coin (Pound Coins); gbp_100_bill (Hundred-Pound Bills); cny_1_coin (Yuan Coins); cny_100_bill (Hundred-Yuan Bills); inr_1_coin (Rupee Coins); inr_100_bill (Hundred-Rupee Bills); krw_1_coin (Won Coins); krw_1000_bill (Thousand-Won Bills); rub_1_coin (Ruble Coins); rub_100_bill (Hundred-Ruble Bills); try_1_coin (Lira Coins); try_100_bill (Hundred-Lira Bills); chf_1_coin (Franc Coins); chf_100_bill (Hundred-Franc Bills); brl_1_coin (Real Coins); brl_100_bill (Hundred-Real Bills)

tools.name: number_of_items
tools.title: Number Of Items Paid For
tools.description: How many of one item a wealth could buy or pay off, from coffees to superyachts. Prices are approximate U.S. benchmarks in USD.

wealth.description: Amount of money. Accepts plain numbers ("1000000000"), formatted numbers ("1,000,000,000"), or shorthand ("1B", "750B", "1T"). Currency defaults to USD.

typeOfItem.description: Item slug. Thing to buy or pay off. Choose what fits the question: a year of minimum-wage salary and a superyacht make very different points. One of: fancy_coffee ($10 Fancy Coffee); quick_meal ($15 Quick Meal); dinner_with_drinks ($175 Dinner With Drinks); iphone ($1,400 iPhone); month_of_childcare ($1,750 Month Of Childcare); rent_or_mortgage_payment ($3,000 Rent Or Mortgage Payment); year_of_low_minimum_wage_salary (Year Of Low Minimum Wage Salary ($15,080)); year_of_high_minimum_wage_salary (Year Of High Minimum Wage Salary ($32,240)); student_loan_debt ($40K Student Loan Debt); car ($50K Car); year_of_salary_65k (Year Of $65,000 Salary); year_of_salary_100k (Year Of $100,000 Salary); luxury_car ($275K Luxury Car); house ($500K House); yacht ($800K Yacht); supercar ($4M Supercar); island ($30M Island); mansion ($75M Mansion); estate_with_a_mega_mansion ($200M Estate With A Mega-Mansion); luxury_island ($300M Luxury Island); superyacht ($600M Superyacht)

tools.name: growth_of_compound_interest
tools.title: Growth Of Compound Interest
tools.description: How much a wealth grows from compound interest alone, untouched, over a period. Answers "how much does a fortune earn while its owner does nothing?"

wealth.description: Amount of money. Accepts plain numbers ("1000000000"), formatted numbers ("1,000,000,000"), or shorthand ("1B", "750B", "1T"). Currency defaults to USD.

rate.description: Interest rate as a decimal between 0 and 1, exclusive. 0.01 = 1%, 0.05 = 5%. Never clamped: 1 returns "Rate Invalid (1)", 2 returns "Rate Outside Range".

frequency.description: Compounding Frequency: 1 annually, 2 semiannually, 4 quarterly, 12 monthly, 365 daily.

period.description: Duration in years, between 0 and 100, exclusive.

tools.name: comparison
tools.title: Full Comparison Of Two Wealths
tools.description: Complete "them vs. you": runs one expression for both wealths and returns both results plus the ratio between them. Ideal for questions like "how does my net worth compare to a billionaire's?" A ratio.value below 1 means the user's wealth is the larger.

expression.description: Which expression to compute for both wealths.
